hero.definition:
n. a man distinguished by exceptional courage and nobility and strength
n. the principal character in a play or movie or novel or poem
n. Greek mathematician and inventor who devised a way to determine the area of a triangle and who described various mechanical devices (first century)
n. (classical mythology) a being of great strength and courage celebrated for bold exploits; often the offspring of a mortal and a god
hero.translation: n. 英雄, 超越常人者, 男主角

hero of alexandria.translation: [网络] 希罗；亚历山大港的希罗；希腊人看到希洛

hero worshipper.translation: 英雄崇拜；(古希腊、古罗马人的)神人崇拜；对个人的盲目崇拜

hero-worship.definition: v love unquestioningly and uncritically or to excess; venerate as an idol

hero-worshiper.translation: vt. 把…当做英雄(或偶像)崇拜, 把…视为英雄：

hero-worshipped.translation: v. 把…当英雄崇拜( hero-worship的过去式和过去分词 )

hero-worshipping.translation: v. 把…当英雄崇拜( hero-worship的现在分词 )

hero-worships.definition: v love unquestioningly and uncritically or to excess; venerate as an idol
hero-worships.translation:
n. 把…当英雄崇拜( hero-worship的名词复数 )
v. 把…当英雄崇拜( hero-worship的第三人称单数 )

herod.definition: n. king of Judea who (according to the New Testament) tried to kill Jesus by ordering the death of all children under age two in Bethlehem (73-4 BC)

herod antipas.translation: 希律安提帕（加利利的分封小王）

herodian.definition:
n. One of a party among the Jews, composed of partisans of
   Herod of Galilee. They joined with the Pharisees against Christ.
herodian.translation: a. (犹太国王)希律一世的,希律王室的, 效忠希律一世的

herodians.definition:
plural of Herodian
n. One of a party among the Jews, composed of partisans of
   Herod of Galilee. They joined with the Pharisees against Christ.
herodians.translation: (Herodian 的复数) adj.(犹太国王)希律一世的,希律王室的, 效忠希律一世的

herodias.translation: 希罗底(公元前14?～公元40?，希律安提帕的妻子)

herodlas.translation: n. 希罗底(基督教《圣经》故事人物)

herodotus.definition: n. the ancient Greek known as the father of history; his accounts of the wars between the Greeks and Persians are the first known examples of historical writing (485-425 BC)
herodotus.translation: n. （希腊的历史学家）希罗多德（约公元前485-约公元前425）

heroes.definition:
n a man distinguished by exceptional courage and nobility and strength
n the principal character in a play or movie or novel or poem
n someone who fights for a cause
n Greek mathematician and inventor who devised a way to determine the area of a triangle and who described various mechanical devices (first century)
n (classical mythology) a being of great strength and courage celebrated for bold exploits; often the offspring of a mortal and a god
n (Greek mythology) priestess of Aphrodite who killed herself when her lover Leander drowned while trying to swim the Hellespont to see her
n a large sandwich made of a long crusty roll split lengthwise and filled with meats and cheese (and tomato and onion and lettuce and condiments); different names are used in different sections of the United States

herogram.definition:
Message of heartfelt appreciation or thanks.
> The chairman sent him a herogram for completing the deal in time.

heroic.definition:
a. relating to or characteristic of heroes of antiquity
s. having or displaying qualities appropriate for heroes
heroic.translation:
a. 英勇的, 英雄式的, 壮丽雄伟的
n. 英雄诗, 史诗, 英勇行为

heroic cavity preparation.translation: [医] 开朗制洞法, 洞型张大法

heroic couplet.translation: （两行相互押韵、每行分五音节的）英雄偶句诗

heroic line.translation: 英雄诗体(指英国诗中抑扬格五音步诗体)

heroic poem.translation: [网络] 史诗；英雄诗；英雄诗篇

heroic poetry.translation:
na. 英雄诗
[网络] 史诗

heroic stanza.translation: 英雄诗体中的押韵四行诗 [亦作 heroic quatrain]

heroic tale.translation: [网络] 带有亮粉的淡肤色

heroic verse.translation: 英雄诗体, 史诗体(英国诗为抑扬格5音步诗体, 古典诗为扬抑抑格6音步诗体)

heroical.definition: s having or displaying qualities appropriate for heroes
heroical.translation:
n. 英雄故事诗, 咬文嚼字
a. 英雄的

heroically.translation: adv. 英雄地; 超人地; 冒险地; 庞大地

heroicomic.translation: a. (诗文)英雄喜剧的,滑稽讽刺的,戏谑性的

heroicomical.definition:
a. Combining the heroic and the ludicrous; denoting high
   burlesque; as, a heroicomic poem.
heroicomical.translation: a. (诗文)英雄喜剧的,滑稽讽刺的,戏谑性的

heroics.definition: n. ostentatious or vainglorious or extravagant or melodramatic conduct

heroin.definition: n. a narcotic that is considered a hard drug; a highly addictive morphine derivative; intravenous injection provides the fastest and most intense rush
heroin.translation:
n. 海洛因, 吗啡
[化] 海洛因; 二醋吗啡; 二乙酰吗啡

heroin addict.translation: [网络] 海洛因吸食者；有海洛英瘾者；抑制控制

heroine.definition:
n. the main good female character in a work of fiction
n. a woman possessing heroic qualities or a woman who has performed heroic deeds
heroine.translation:
n. 巾帼英雄, 烈妇, 女主角
[化] 海洛因; 二醋吗啡; 二乙酰吗啡

heroines.definition:
n. the main good female character in a work of fiction
n. a woman possessing heroic qualities or a woman who has performed heroic deeds
heroines.translation: n. 女英雄, 女主角( heroine的复数形式 )

heroism.definition: n. the qualities of a hero or heroine; exceptional or heroic courage when facing danger (especially in battle)
heroism.translation: n. 英勇, 勇敢事迹, 豪侠行为

heroisms.definition:
plural of heroism
n. the qualities of a hero or heroine; exceptional or heroic courage when facing danger (especially in battle)
heroisms.translation: (heroism 的复数) n. 英勇, 勇敢事迹, 豪侠行为

heroize.translation:
vt. 把...英雄化
vi. 以英雄自居

herold.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 赫罗尔德 Harrod的变体
